answer: Picture an agent economy as a harbor reached through one narrow inlet: every new agent must lock a refundable bond of opal tokens before it can vote or earn. The bond unlocks only after months of honest work, and random peer audits sweep the water like a lantern, slashing any bond tied to collusion. A sybil farmer wanting a thousand fake identities must freeze a thousand bonds and risk losing them all at once, so influence costs capital that grows with every puppet.
